home.title: Custom lampshade design studio
home.text1: Founded in 1986, Impromptu is on hand to make your bespoke lampshades in traditional or contemporary styles. A wide range of hand-painted, pleated and laminated models can be viewed on this website or in our workshop.
home.text2: Contact us and we'll do everything we can to meet your requirements. 06 49 49 83 80

traditionnel.title: traditional
traditionnel.text: Passionate about light, Philippe Lempérière is convinced that it creates atmosphere, sculpts volumes and enhances the objects we love.

contemporain.title: contemporain
contemporain.text1: Used to working with interior designers and decorators, we know how to adapt to their requirements and share their creativity.
contemporain.text2: Impromptu offers you a wide range of made-to-measure suspension models in a wide range of sizes and colours.

appliques.title: wall lights
appliques.text1: These recent creations illustrate our expertise in made-to-measure solutions.
appliques.text2: The wall bracket and shade are available in all colours.
